newsitem.title: USA: FERC sets meeting on power market bulletin boards.
newsitem.headline: FERC sets meeting on power market bulletin boards.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission said Wednesday it would hold a conference on July 18 to assess the electric utility industry's progress in setting up information systems to track wholesale power transmission deals.

The review, one year after the commission required utilities to open their transmission lines to competing power producers, will focus on whether the Open Access Same-Time Information System (OASIS) was working.

The system is supposed to allow utilities and their competitors who use the utilities' wires to see information about transmission operations at the same time, in order to ensure that utility power generators do not have an unfair advantage over rival power producers.
